constraints: The diff must stay deterministic and byte-exact; no heuristic or approximate matching
description: Validation and queries compute each distinct before/after byte diff once per process
rationale: Whole-file SequenceMatcher is quadratic: validation repeated it per binding per event (about 7.5s each for cli.py), so adding bindings made commits minutes slower. Telos reviews flagged the same N+1 scan pattern in its context query.
requirements: Each distinct before/after byte pair is diffed at most once per process
Memoization must not change computed intervals or relocated ranges
title: Single byte diff per file pair
